Juno (Design): Quick UX timebox on the vectors / relevance table. Two small but important issues from usability tests: 1) users can't quickly tell whether Export applies to selection or viewport, and 2) keyboard users lose context when rows expand. Figma: https://redwood.ai/s/vec-scan :mag:
Marcus (Frontend): Noted. For export scoping I propose an affordance: the export button shows the current scope in the label, e.g., `Export (selected: 3)` and the dropdown has clear options: `Selected (3)`, `Visible (200)`, `All (15000)`. We'll surface counts dynamically. That should reduce ambiguity.
Tess (A11y): Good approach. Also add an aria-live region that announces export start/complete like "Export started: 3 vectors" so screen reader users get feedback. For expanded rows, ensure focus moves into the panel and we set `aria-hidden` on collapsed content. Use `role=region` with an accessible name on the expanded panel so NVDA/VoiceOver announces it.
Priya (PM): From interviews: users want two file formats: CSV (simple) and JSON (full vectors + metadata). Default to CSV for non-technical users; keep JSON as an advanced option. Also log analytics: export_scope, export_format, export_count. Can we also add a warning for very large exports (e.g., >5000 rows) that suggests using `Export all (background)`?
Zac (Design Intern): Mocked an inline label next to the export button and a tiny badge for counts. Also tried a toast pattern for long-running exports with a link to the background job page. Screenshot: https://redwood.ai/s/mock-export-badge.png :art:
Marcus (Frontend): Technical notes: for big exports we'll kick off a background job and return a job id. Implementations: POST /exports {scope, format, query} -> 202 + job_id. We'll show a toast with progress and link to `/console/exports/{job_id}`. For small exports (<2000 rows) we can stream the response as a download. Also will add `aria-busy` on the export button while the request runs.
Tess (A11y): Please ensure the toast is focusable and has `role=status` or `role=alert` depending on urgency. For background exports, the toast should include `aria-describedby` to the progress text. We'll test with NVDA.
Priya (PM): UX copy suggestions: change button text to `Export` and use secondary text for scope e.g., `Export • selected: 3`. For the dropdown items use helper copy: `Selected (exports only rows youve selected)`, `Visible (exports rows in current view)`, `All (exports entire dataset)` — short and actionable. Also add a tiny info icon linking to docs about export limits and data retention.
Juno (Design): Love that. Also row expand keyboard flow: accept arrow-right to expand, arrow-left to collapse; Enter toggles. When expanding, focus should move to the first focusable control inside (copy, copy-vec, download). Add a small skip link `Skip to next row` for keyboard power users.
Marcus (Frontend): I'll add `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, and ensure `tabindex` ordering moves into the panel. For the skip link we can add `data-skip-target` and JS to focus the next `.row`. Branch `feat/vec-export-scan` with storybook knobs for export scope/counts. ETA: end of day tomorrow.
ci-bot: Storybook preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/builds/1987654321-storybook 12 (includes export scope badge, aria-live, toast jobs).
Tess (A11y): Quick checklist: aria-live for export announcements, focus management on expand/collapse, toast role/status, aria labels for export options, announce large-export warnings. We'll run a short NVDA script after the PR.
Priya (PM): I'll add analytics spec and docs text for translations. Let's gate behind `vec-export-clarity` flag and pilot with 5% of users. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
